name: kubernetes-postgres-scaling
description: P1 Proof: AGBoss on Kubernetes and PostgreSQL — a backlog scales the workers out, a killed and a frozen worker are recovered and fenced, every job and every external side effect happens exactly once, verified from state; then the workers scale in. KEDA on the core's OpenTelemetry metrics through the official Prometheus exporter.

scripts.check: agboss check --application src/local/local-scaling.application.ts --strict --cassettes && agboss check --strict --cassettes && tsc --noEmit && eslint .
